content.markdown: The package manifest for SNL-Basics version `0.3.3` in its public beta series. The package name is `@sjtu-ai4math/snl-basics`, and its public entry points expose SNL syntax-tree parsing, KaTeX-in-React rendering, and complete Entry rendering. Macro data remains consumer-owned.
